edges.description: Endothelial activation and damage can disrupt barrier integrity and increase vascular permeability.
Increased vascular permeability is expressed clinically as capillary leak.
Severe plasma leakage can contribute to shock through intravascular volume depletion and hypotension.
Consumption of coagulation components can contribute to hemorrhagic manifestations.
Consumptive hemostatic dysfunction is clinically detected as coagulopathy.
Reduced coagulation-factor availability can increase bleeding risk.
Reduced coagulation-factor availability contributes to an abnormal coagulation profile.
Reduced platelet number is clinically detected as thrombocytopenia.
Reduced platelet number can contribute to hemorrhagic manifestations.
Platelet dysfunction can contribute to hemorrhagic manifestations.
